newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's Bondi Beach fenced off for Christmas.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Bondi Beach fenced off for Christmas.

text.p: Australia's Bondi Beach will be partly fenced off on Christmas Day and revellers will have to buy admission tickets in an attempt to avoid a repeat of last year's riot.
Police surveillance cameras would also be installed along the beach and nearby roads which will be closed to traffic, authorities said on Thursday.
Australian police in riot gear clashed with hundreds of Christmas revellers last year as crowds attacked a bus and cars at Sydney's most famous beach.
The New South Wales state government and local council on Thursday announced "Sunsplashed" -- an organised, ticketed Christmas party for Bondi.
"In light of revellers' behaviour in recent years, alcohol consumption will be restricted to the Sunsplashed enclosure," the government and council said in a joint statement.
The annual Bondi Beach Christmas Day party attracts around 20,000 people, many of them foreigners.
Organisers said they hoped this year's festivities would restore Bondi's image, tarnished by last year's riot and the murder in September of a British man.
